mechanism_narrative: A positive year-over-year growth rate in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to improved corporate earnings prospects.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances where the year-over-year GDPC1 growth rate is positive (p-value < 0.05 for the null hypothesis that the return is positive in 55% of cases).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2.0%, it indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to lower discount rates and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 2.0% (p-value < 0.05 for the null hypothesis that the return is positive in 55% of cases).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and strong industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates a tight labor market and robust economic activity, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to sustained corporate profit growth.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5% and INDPRO > 100 (p-value < 0.05 for the null hypothesis that the return is positive in 55% of cases).

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), monetary policy tightening is expected, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced risk appetite and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (y/y) (p-value < 0.05 for the null hypothesis that the return is negative in 55% of cases).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened recession fears.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0 (p-value < 0.05 for the null hypothesis that the return is negative in 55% of cases).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300.0, it indicates a strong housing market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 1300.0 (p-value < 0.05 for the null hypothesis that the return is positive in 55% of cases).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong residential fixed investment (RSAFS > 500000.0) and high housing starts (HOUST > 1300.0) indicates a robust housing sector, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to positive spillovers into consumer and business confidence.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS > 500000.0 and HOUST > 1300.0 (p-value < 0.05 for the null hypothesis that the return is positive in 55% of cases).

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), labor market tightness supports sustained economic growth, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to improved corporate earnings and reduced recession risk.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% (p-value < 0.05 for the null hypothesis that the return is positive in 55% of cases).
